newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombia peso falls as central bank buys dollars.
newsitem.headline: Colombia peso falls as central bank buys dollars.

text.p: Colombia's peso fell back a further 0.34 to 1,0001.1 pesos per dollar as the central bank continued intervening in the markets to prop up the greenback.
Small quantities of petro-dollars and coffee export earnings continued to enter the market, forcing the central bank to step in to buoy the dollar and force down the peso.
"Today's markets were very boring, almost dead. The central bank did intervene but it's difficult to say by how much," one Bogota trader said.
Dealers reported 102 trades worth a total $135 million. The peso reached an intraday high of 1,001.09 and an intraday low of 1,001.16.
"Profit margins were virtually zero today because of the narrow band of fluctuation," another trader said.
